requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle from submission and approval by a Public Relations Officer to assignment, execution (by internal staff or external maintainers), and resolution. The system supports anonymity, two-way communication between citizens and operators, real-time notifications (email/push), and detailed public/private statistics.

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to choose whether to make my report anonymous 
So that my name is not shown in the public list of reports.
constraints: Anonymous option protects privacy. Choice made at issue description time.
expected_behaviors: my name is not shown in the public list of reports

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user 
I want to search for reports in a specific area by typing in an address
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area.
constraints: You can choose how much to zoom in. The product owner will then provide feedback on the implementation.
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

requirements.text:
As a citizen /unregistered user
I want to see public statistics about reports 
So that I understand trends in city issues.
constraints: Public statistics  (visible on the site) include the number of reports by category and trends by day, week, or month.
expected_behaviors: I understand trends in city issues

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator 
I want to see detailed private statistics 
So that I can monitor usage and performance of the system.
constraints:
Private statistics (for administrators only), in addition to public ones, also include charts and tables about:  
  - number of reports by status  
  - number of reports by type  
  - number of reports by type and status  
  - number of reports by reporter  
  - number of reports by reporter and type  
  - number of reports by reporter, type and status  
  - number of reports by the top 1% of reporters, by type  
  - number of reports by the top 5% of reporters, by type
expected_behaviors: I can monitor usage and performance of the system

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office based on category.
Rejected reports require a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Once submitted, a report cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public Turin map of reports for citizens.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator and must have their own individual account.
Case 1 (External maintainer has access): Internal comments between staff and maintainer are report-specific and reserved (not visible to reporter/citizens).
Case 2 (External maintainer no access): Communication happens out of Participium; technical office updates status to 'Resolved' externally.
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Public statistics include number of reports by category and trends by day/week/month.
Private statistics (admin only) include breakdowns by status, type, reporter, and combinations including top 1% and 5% reporters.
Email is a mandatory field for registration and can be used for login.
Confirmation code for registration is valid for 30 minutes.
edge_cases: When zooming out on the map, reports are grouped into a cumulative report showing the total number.
When zooming in on the map, reports are separated, displaying title and reporter name (or 'anonymous').
If a citizen disables email notifications in their configuration panel, they do not receive email copies of platform notifications.
A municipality user can have multiple roles, serving on more than one technical office.
Public Relation officer can assign a report either to a specific technical office or directly to a staff member of that office.
Notifications/messages can be set to be sent in real time or when the page is refreshed, depending on preference.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to the central administrative body responsible for initial review and rejection explanations.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires the user to have provided a valid Telegram username in their profile.
The 'top 1%' and 'top 5%' reporters are calculated based on volume of reports submitted.
Unregistered users can view reports but cannot submit new ones or follow reports.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
strategy_items.prompt: Register a new citizen user with a valid email, password, and username. Verify the response indicates successful registration or returns a confirmation code if applicable per domain rules.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the entry point for user access and registration flow.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with an invalid email format.
strategy_items.prompt: Attempt to register a user providing an email address that does not match standard email format (e.g., 'user@'). Verify the system rejects the request.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Ensures input validation on mandatory fields like email.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff assigns a report to an external maintainer.
strategy_items.prompt: First, create a report via POST /reports. Then, authenticate as 'technical office staff member'. Perform the PUT request to assign an external maintainer to the existing report.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
POST /reports with valid data to create a new report resource.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created report via POST /reports logic (or verify no resource exists if deletion endpoint differs; assume standard cleanup of created resources).
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the workflow dependency where a report must exist before assignment.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of an assigned report.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as 'external maintainer'. Perform a PUT request to update the status of a report previously assigned to them. Verify the status changes successfully.
setup_needed: PUT /offices/reports/{reportId}/assign-external to assign the report (simulated or pre-existing state).
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created report resource if it was created for this test.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the external maintainer's ability to update their assigned tasks.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff updates report statuses.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as 'technical office staff member'. Perform a PUT request to update the status of a report (e.g., from Pending Approval to Assigned). Verify the status transition.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the core workflow of status management by technical office staff.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen attempts verification with an expired confirmation code.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute verification using a confirmation code that is older than 30 minutes (per domain rules). Expect rejection due to code expiration.
setup_needed: POST /auth/register-request with valid citizen email and name; capture returned confirmation code.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the 30-minute validity constraint mentioned in domain rules.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator sets up a new municipality user.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new municipality user with valid details (name, email, role). Verify the user is created and accessible for subsequent operations like role assignment.
setup_needed: Ensure authenticated session exists for 'system administrator' role.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE /admin/users/{userId} if the created user ID is returned and accessible; otherwise verify no resource was created.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the ability to create users as per PT02.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to an existing municipality user.
strategy_items.prompt: Assign a specific role (e.g., 'Technical Office Staff') to the user created in the setup step. Verify the role assignment is successful and reflected in the user profile.
setup_needed: POST /admin/users to create a municipality user; capture userId.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates role assignment functionality per PT03.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen submits a report with the anonymous flag set to true.
strategy_items.prompt: Submit a new report with details and set 'anonymous' to true. Verify that the system accepts the request and stores the report with the anonymous flag, ensuring name is hidden in public views (per domain rules).
setup_needed: Ensure authenticated session exists for 'citizen' role.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the anonymous reporting feature per PT15 and domain rules.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Municipal public relations officer reviews and approves or rejects reports.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a happy path test where the Municipal Public Relations Officer authenticates, retrieves a report in 'Pending Approval' state, and updates it to 'Accepted'. Verify the response indicates success and the report status changes.
setup_needed: Authenticate as Municipal Public Relations Officer via /auth/login.
Ensure a report exists in 'Pending Approval' state (created by citizen or system).
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present. Note: The PUT operation modifies an existing resource, so cleanup focuses on ensuring the modification is reversible or logged appropriately.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core workflow for report approval as defined in PT06.
